reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004AD004 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/mathsys/004AD004-MathSys_Invoke3.cpp at sha256 e55b6e6aaa700c8c79ef3fadfa1c5abc4832e9cb7cd7a9ac73f62c32478038cb (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t __convention MathSys_Invoke3("regparm")(int32_t param_1, int32_t param_2, int32_t param_3, int32_t* param_4, void* param_5, void* param_6, int32_t param_7);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t __convention("regparm")(int32_t arg1, int32_t arg2, int32_t arg3, int32_t* arg4 @ ebp, void* arg5 @ esi, void* arg6 @ edi, int32_t arg7)" at 0x004AD004; radare2 recovers "fcn.004ad004 ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x004AD004 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t __convention MathSys_Invoke3("regparm")(int32_t param_1, int32_t param_2, int32_t param_3, int32_t* param_4, void* param_5, void* param_6, int32_t param_7);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
